"""One authorized same-version source-build preparation, separate from inference."""
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path
from urllib.parse import urlsplit

META = dict(artifact_status='experimental_unvalidated', operator_approved=False,
            formal_gate_status='not_run_not_passed')
CHANNEL = 'https://conda.anaconda.org/conda-forge'
ATTEMPT = 's0_cpu_prepare_r3a'
BUILD_ENV = 'bio_build_glibc217_r2'
ARCHIVE_SHA = '731b17a23514bf2460083d4585a42d5ece4137643960c354469790857af52735'
SOURCES = {
    'numexpr': dict(version='2.14.1', filename='numexpr-2.14.1.tar.gz',
        url='https://files.pythonhosted.org/packages/cb/2f/fdba158c9dbe5caca9c3eca3eaffffb251f2fb8674bf8e2d0aed5f38d319/numexpr-2.14.1.tar.gz',
        bytes=119400, sha256='4be00b1086c7b7a5c32e31558122b7b80243fe098579b170967da83f3152b48b'),
    'connected-components-3d': dict(version='4.1.1', filename='connected_components_3d-4.1.1.tar.gz',
        url='https://files.pythonhosted.org/packages/23/66/62eeb4d29188a1161289c58c9129294856ce0f134fb9b49c3d13ae0db1d1/connected_components_3d-4.1.1.tar.gz',
        bytes=85178, sha256='becc200f0b9fd8c16ffe0ddb37c94a963737b96b79705c8ae25dd141f402f990'),
    'ndindex': dict(version='1.10.1', filename='ndindex-1.10.1.tar.gz',
        url='https://files.pythonhosted.org/packages/f5/92/4b9d2f4e0f3eabcfc7b02b48261f6e5ad36a3e2c1bbdcc4e3b7b6c768fa6/ndindex-1.10.1.tar.gz',
        bytes=271395, sha256='0f6113c1f031248f8818cbee1aa92aa3c9472b7701debcce9fddebcd2f610f11'),
}


def require(ok, message):
    if not ok:
        raise RuntimeError(message)


def sha(path):
    h = hashlib.sha256()
    with Path(path).open('rb') as stream:
        for block in iter(lambda: stream.read(1024**2), b''):
            h.update(block)
    return h.hexdigest()


def write(path, payload):
    path = Path(path)
    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    with path.open('x') as stream:
        json.dump(dict(META, **payload), stream, indent=2, sort_keys=True, allow_nan=False)
        stream.write('\n')
    path.chmod(0o440)


def prior_guard(root):
    root = Path(root)
    result = {}
    for name in ('bio_intel_py310', 'bio_intel_py310_r2', 'bio_intel_py310_r3'):
        prefix = root / 'envs' / name
        require(prefix.is_dir(), 'old environment absent: ' + name)
        result[name] = {str(p.relative_to(prefix)): sha(p)
                        for p in sorted((prefix / 'conda-meta').glob('*')) if p.is_file()}
        result[name]['bin/python'] = sha(prefix / 'bin/python')
    markers = ('operator/ENV_INSTALL_FAILED.json', 'operator/environment_r2/FAILED.json',
               'operator/environment_r3/FAILED.json', 'operator/environment_r4_preflight/FAILED.json',
               'operator/environment_r4_official_preflight_r2/FAILED.json',
               'operator/asset_materialization/FAILED.json')
    result['failures'] = {name: sha(root / name) for name in markers}
    return result


def validate_build_plan(plan):
    require(plan.get('success') is True, 'build environment solver failed')
    selected = plan['actions']['LINK']
    require(len({x['name'] for x in selected}) == len(selected), 'duplicate build packages')
    versions = {x['name']: x['version'] for x in selected}
    for name, value in {'python': '3.10.22', 'numpy': '2.2.6', 'sysroot_linux-64': '2.17'}.items():
        require(versions.get(name) == value, 'build version drift: ' + name)
    for name in ('gcc_linux-64', 'gxx_linux-64', 'binutils_linux-64', 'setuptools', 'wheel', 'cython', 'pip', 'tomli', 'packaging'):
        require(name in versions, 'build tool missing: ' + name)
    require(versions['gcc_linux-64'].split('.')[0] == versions['gxx_linux-64'].split('.')[0] == '13',
            'compiler generation drift')
    for item in [*selected, *plan['actions'].get('FETCH', [])]:
        require(item['name'] not in ('torch', 'pytorch', 'torchvision', 'pytorch-cuda'), 'model dependency in build env')
        require(item.get('platform', item.get('subdir')) in ('linux-64', 'noarch'), 'build platform drift')
        urls = [item.get(k) for k in ('url', 'base_url', 'channel')
                if isinstance(item.get(k), str) and '://' in item[k]]
        require(urls, 'absolute build package origin missing')
        for url in urls:
            parsed = urlsplit(url)
            require(parsed.scheme == 'https' and parsed.netloc == 'conda.anaconda.org'
                    and (parsed.path == '/conda-forge' or parsed.path.startswith('/conda-forge/'))
                    and not parsed.query and not parsed.fragment, 'build package origin drift')
    return selected


def parent_staging_guard(root):
    parent=Path(root)/'attempts/s0_cpu_prepare_r1'
    require(sha(parent/'reports/STAGING_FAILED.json')=='be077b174c4975aa0ee7daa26dfd562816d726f0c71be433f19fcf0c54960ee6',
            'parent CPU staging failure SHA drift')
    return {str(p.relative_to(parent)):sha(p) for p in sorted(parent.rglob('*')) if p.is_file()}

def parent_r2_guard(root):
    parent=Path(root)/'attempts/s0_cpu_prepare_r2'
    require(sha(parent/'contract/PREPARATION_CONTRACT.json')=='8a2246326f58d7351712785e2395c54fb81949ad7a4390f19e18e80980329980', 'parent R2 contract drift')
    require(sha(parent/'slurm/prepare.slurm')=='d879a1addf9756b3bfa8561b96e33f600deb87c1b14f9483e79217d8506620ff', 'parent R2 Slurm drift')
    require(sha(parent/'operator/submit_usage_r2/SUBMISSION_RECEIPT.json')=='592c93f24b50993446ff38210c5e0ef352a554beb7c0c3dea147b41ee4f71eda', 'parent R2 receipt drift')
    paths=[p for p in sorted(parent.rglob('*')) if p.is_file()]
    require(len(paths)<100 and all(p.stat().st_size<1024**2 for p in paths), 'parent R2 light identity budget')
    return {str(p.relative_to(parent)):sha(p) for p in paths}

def r3_evidence_guard(attempt, contract):
    for relative,key in [('contract/USER_AUTHORIZATION.json','user_authorization_sha256'),
                         ('contract/BOOTSTRAP_VERIFICATION.json','bootstrap_verification_sha256'),
                         ('contract/BUILD_ENV_EXPLICIT.txt','build_env_explicit_sha256'),
                         ('reports/SOURCE_BUILD_REQUIREMENTS.json','source_build_requirements_sha256')]:
        require(sha(Path(attempt)/relative)==contract[key], 'R3 evidence drift: '+relative)

"""Render and audit the single authorized CPU job; never submits by itself."""
from pathlib import Path
import re
import shlex


def render_slurm(attempt, build_env, conda, contract_sha):
    attempt = Path(attempt)
    assert attempt.is_absolute() and attempt.name == 's0_cpu_prepare_r3a'
    assert Path(build_env).is_absolute() and Path(build_env).name == 'bio_build_glibc217_r2'
    assert re.fullmatch('[0-9a-f]{64}', contract_sha)
    quote = shlex.quote
    return '\n'.join([
        '#!/bin/bash', '#SBATCH --job-name=s2exts0p3a', '#SBATCH --partition=cpu_192G',
        '#SBATCH --nodes=1', '#SBATCH --ntasks=1', '#SBATCH --cpus-per-task=8',
        '#SBATCH --mem=64G', '#SBATCH --time=04:00:00', '#SBATCH --no-requeue', '#SBATCH --export=NONE',
        '#SBATCH --output='+str(attempt/'logs/s2exts0p3a_%j.out'),
        '#SBATCH --error='+str(attempt/'logs/s2exts0p3a_%j.err'),
        'set -eo pipefail', 'umask 077', 'source /etc/profile',
        'source '+quote(str(Path(conda).parent.parent/'etc/profile.d/conda.sh')),
        'conda activate '+quote(str(build_env)), 'module load singularity-ce/4.1.1', 'set -u',
        'unset http_proxy https_proxy all_proxy HTTP_PROXY HTTPS_PROXY ALL_PROXY',
        'export PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 LC_ALL=C CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=',
        'export OMP_NUM_THREADS=8 MKL_NUM_THREADS=8 MAX_JOBS=8 CMAKE_BUILD_PARALLEL_LEVEL=8',
        'export PIP_NO_INDEX=1 PIP_CONFIG_FILE=/dev/null PIP_DISABLE_PIP_VERSION_CHECK=1',
        'export TMPDIR='+quote(str(attempt/'scratch')),
        'export S0_EXPECTED_CONTRACT_SHA256='+quote(contract_sha),
        'cd '+quote(str(attempt)),
        'exec "$CONDA_PREFIX/bin/python" -B '+quote(str(attempt/'runtime/prepare_s0_cpu_r3a.py'))+' --attempt '+quote(str(attempt)),
        '',
    ])


def job_fields(text):
    pattern=r'(?:^|\s)(?:(?P<key>[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_/:]*)=|(?P<legacy>NtasksPerTRES):)'
    tokens=list(re.finditer(pattern,text))
    result={}
    for index,token in enumerate(tokens):
        key=token.group('key') or token.group('legacy')
        assert key not in result, 'duplicate Slurm field: '+key
        end=tokens[index+1].start() if index+1<len(tokens) else len(text)
        result[key]=text[token.end():end].strip()
    return result


def memory_mib(value):
    match = re.fullmatch(r'(\d+)([KMGT]?)', value)
    assert match, 'unrecognized Slurm memory'
    n, suffix = match.groups()
    return int(n)*{'':1,'K':1/1024,'M':1,'G':1024,'T':1024**2}[suffix]


def validate_held(text, job_id, attempt, allowed_accounts):
    f = job_fields(text)
    attempt = Path(attempt)
    expected = {'JobId':job_id, 'JobName':'s2exts0p3a', 'JobState':'PENDING', 'Reason':'JobHeldUser',
                'Priority':'0', 'Partition':'cpu_192G', 'NumCPUs':'8', 'NumTasks':'1', 'CPUs/Task':'8',
                'Requeue':'0', 'Command':str(attempt/'slurm/prepare.slurm'), 'WorkDir':str(attempt)}
    for key,value in expected.items():
        assert f.get(key) == value, 'CPU held identity drift: '+key
    assert f.get('Account') in allowed_accounts, 'CPU held account not authorized'
    assert f.get('UserId','').split('(')[0] == 'zqchen', 'CPU held owner drift'
    assert f.get('NumNodes') in ('1','1-1'), 'CPU held node count drift'
    assert f.get('TimeLimit') in ('04:00:00','4:00:00'), 'CPU held walltime drift'
    assert memory_mib(f.get('MinMemoryNode','')) == 65536, 'CPU held memory drift'
    assert f.get('Dependency') in ('(null)','None'), 'unexpected CPU dependency'
    assert not re.search('gpu', '|'.join(f.get(k,'') for k in ('TRES','ReqTRES','Gres','TresPerNode')), re.I), 'GPU in CPU held request'
    for key,suffix in [('StdOut','out'),('StdErr','err')]:
        assert f.get(key) in (str(attempt/f'logs/s2exts0p3a_{job_id}.{suffix}'),
                              str(attempt/f'logs/s2exts0p3a_%j.{suffix}')), 'CPU held log path drift'
    return f

"""Read headed Slurm QoS tables; never infer limits from column positions."""
import csv
import io
import re


def parse_qos_table(text):
    rows=list(csv.reader(io.StringIO(text),delimiter='|'))
    assert len(rows)>1, 'headed QoS table absent'
    header=[x.strip() for x in rows[0]]
    assert header.count('Name')==1 and len({x for x in header if x})==len([x for x in header if x]), 'QoS header ambiguous'
    result={}
    for values in rows[1:]:
        if not values:continue
        assert len(values)==len(header), 'truncated QoS row'
        row={k:v.strip() for k,v in zip(header,values) if k}
        assert row['Name'] and row['Name'] not in result, 'duplicate or empty QoS name'
        result[row['Name']]=row
    return result


def _limit(row,aliases):
    keys=[key for key in aliases if key in row]
    assert len(keys)==1, 'required QoS limit header absent or ambiguous: '+aliases[0]
    return row[keys[0]]


def wall_seconds(value):
    if value in ('','UNLIMITED','NONE'):return None
    match=re.fullmatch(r'(?:(\d+)-)?(\d+):(\d{2}):(\d{2})',value)
    assert match, 'unsupported QoS wall time'
    days,hours,minutes,seconds=match.groups()
    return int(days or 0)*86400+int(hours)*3600+int(minutes)*60+int(seconds)


def validate_cpu_qos(rows,names,existing_jobs,cpus=8,mem_mib=65536,wall=14400):
    checked={}
    for name in names:
        assert name in rows, 'applicable QoS absent: '+name
        row=rows[name]
        maximum=wall_seconds(_limit(row,('MaxWall','MaxWallDurationPerJob')))
        assert maximum is None or maximum>=wall, 'CPU request exceeds QoS wall'
        tres=_limit(row,('MaxTRES','MaxTRESPJ','MaxTRESPerJob'))
        limits={}
        if tres:
            for item in tres.split(','):
                key,value=item.split('=',1)
                assert key not in limits, 'duplicate QoS TRES'
                limits[key]=value
        if limits.get('cpu'):assert int(limits['cpu'])>=cpus, 'CPU request exceeds QoS CPUs'
        if limits.get('mem'):assert memory_mib(limits['mem'])>=mem_mib, 'CPU request exceeds QoS memory'
        max_jobs=_limit(row,('MaxJobsPU','MaxJobsPerUser','MaxJobs'))
        max_submit=_limit(row,('MaxSubmitPU','MaxSubmitJobsPU','MaxSubmitJobsPerUser','MaxSubmitJobs'))
        if max_jobs:assert int(max_jobs)>=1, 'QoS disallows running jobs'
        if max_submit:assert int(max_submit)>existing_jobs, 'QoS submission limit reached'
        checked[name]=dict(max_wall_seconds=maximum,max_TRES_per_job=limits,
                           max_jobs_per_user=max_jobs,max_submit_jobs_per_user=max_submit)
    return checked


def validate_cpu_snapshot(snapshot):
    scheduler=snapshot['scheduler']
    for name,item in scheduler.items():
        if name!='quota':assert item['returncode']==0, 'scheduler command failed: '+name
    assert scheduler['libc']['stdout'].strip()=='glibc 2.17', 'real host libc drift'
    partition=job_fields(scheduler['partition']['stdout'])
    assert partition['PartitionName']=='cpu_192G' and partition['State']=='UP', 'CPU partition unavailable'
    assert partition['AllowGroups']=='ALL', 'CPU partition group restriction not reviewed'
    assert partition['RootOnly']=='NO' and partition['ReqResv']=='NO', 'CPU partition requires special access'
    limit=wall_seconds(partition['MaxTime'])
    assert limit is None or limit>=14400, 'CPU partition wall limit'
    if partition['MaxMemPerNode']!='UNLIMITED':
        assert memory_mib(partition['MaxMemPerNode'])>=65536, 'CPU partition memory limit'
    if partition['MaxCPUsPerNode']!='UNLIMITED':
        assert int(partition['MaxCPUsPerNode'])>=8, 'CPU partition CPU limit'
    if partition['MaxNodes']!='UNLIMITED':assert int(partition['MaxNodes'])>=1, 'CPU partition node limit'
    assert int(partition['MinNodes'])<=1, 'CPU partition minimum nodes'
    associations=list(csv.DictReader(io.StringIO(scheduler['association']['stdout']),delimiter='|'))
    eligible=[r for r in associations if r['User']=='zqchen' and r['Account']=='zqchen'
              and r['Partition'] in ('','cpu_192G')]
    assert len(eligible)==1, 'CPU association absent or ambiguous'
    association=eligible[0]
    assert partition['AllowAccounts']=='ALL' or 'zqchen' in partition['AllowAccounts'].split(','), 'CPU account disallowed'
    queue=[line.split('|') for line in scheduler['own_queue']['stdout'].splitlines() if line]
    assert all(len(row)==6 for row in queue), 'CPU queue schema drift'
    count=len(queue)
    for key in ('MaxJobs','MaxSubmit'):
        assert key in association, 'association limit header absent'
        if association[key]:assert int(association[key])>count, 'association job limit reached'
    rows=parse_qos_table(scheduler['qos']['stdout'])
    canonical={}
    for name in rows:
        assert name.lower() not in canonical, 'case-ambiguous QoS names'
        canonical[name.lower()]=name
    requested=[partition['QoS'],*association['QOS'].split(',')]
    assert all(name and not name.startswith(('+','-')) for name in requested), 'QoS inheritance not resolved'
    assert all(name.lower() in canonical for name in requested), 'applicable QoS absent'
    names=list(dict.fromkeys(canonical[name.lower()] for name in requested))
    allowed=partition['AllowQos']
    if allowed!='ALL':
        assert all(name.lower() in allowed.lower().split(',') for name in association['QOS'].split(',')), 'CPU QoS disallowed'
    checked=validate_cpu_qos(rows,names,count)
    for name in names:
        row=rows[name]
        for key in ('GrpTRES','GrpTRESMins','GrpTRESRunMins','GrpJobs','GrpSubmit','GrpWall','MaxTRESMins'):
            assert not row.get(key), 'shared or runtime QoS limit requires usage audit: '+key
        for key in ('MaxTRESPU','MaxTRESPA'):
            if row.get(key):
                validate_cpu_usage_limit(snapshot,row,key)
                limits=dict(item.split('=',1) for item in row[key].split(','))
                if 'cpu' in limits:assert int(limits['cpu'])>=8, 'aggregate CPU QoS limit'
                if 'mem' in limits:assert memory_mib(limits['mem'])>=65536, 'aggregate memory QoS limit'
                assert set(limits)<= {'cpu','mem','node'}, 'aggregate QoS resource not reviewed'
                if 'node' in limits:assert int(limits['node'])>=1, 'aggregate node QoS limit'
        for key in ('MaxJobsPA','MaxSubmitPA'):
            if row.get(key):assert int(row[key])>count, 'account QoS job limit reached'
    nodes=[line.split('|') for line in scheduler['nodes']['stdout'].splitlines() if line]
    assert nodes and all(len(row)==5 for row in nodes), 'CPU node table schema drift'
    suitable=[r[0] for r in nodes if r[1] in ('idle','mix','alloc') and int(r[2])>=8 and int(r[3])>=65536]
    assert suitable, 'no configured CPU node meets request'
    assert snapshot['free_bytes']>150*1024**3, 'CPU preparation filesystem capacity below reservation'
    return dict(status='CPU_scheduler_request_eligible_not_running_or_full_capacity_pass',
                account='zqchen',partition='cpu_192G',applicable_qos=names,checked_qos=checked,
                association=association,existing_jobs=count,suitable_configured_nodes=suitable,
                requested_resource=dict(cpus=8,memory_mib=65536,wall_seconds=14400,gpu=0),
                filesystem_free_bytes=snapshot['free_bytes'],CPU_reservation_bytes=150*1024**3,
                quota_query=scheduler['quota'],numeric_quota_verified=False,full_inference_capacity_pass=False)

"""Coherent own-job CPU upper bounds for the authorized per-user QoS gate."""
import hashlib
import re
import subprocess
import time


STATES = {'PENDING', 'RUNNING', 'CONFIGURING', 'COMPLETING', 'SUSPENDED', 'STOPPED', 'RESIZING'}


def queue_records(text):
    records = {}
    for line in text.splitlines():
        if not line:
            continue
        values = line.split('|')
        assert len(values) == 6, 'CPU usage queue schema drift'
        identity, state, partition, name, _, _ = values
        assert re.fullmatch(r'[0-9]+', identity) and identity not in records, 'CPU usage JobID ambiguous'
        assert state in STATES and partition and name, 'CPU usage job state or identity unreviewed'
        records[identity] = dict(state=state, partition=partition, name=name)
    assert len(records) <= 100, 'CPU usage job metadata budget'
    return records


def job_cpu_record(fields, identity, expected):
    assert fields.get('JobId') == identity, 'CPU usage job identity drift'
    assert fields.get('JobState') == expected['state'], 'CPU usage job state changed'
    assert fields.get('Partition') == expected['partition'], 'CPU usage partition changed'
    assert fields.get('JobName') == expected['name'], 'CPU usage job name changed'
    assert fields.get('UserId', '').split('(')[0] == 'zqchen', 'CPU usage owner drift'
    assert fields.get('Account') == 'zqchen' and fields.get('QOS'), 'CPU usage account or QoS unreviewed'
    num_cpus = fields.get('NumCPUs', '')
    assert re.fullmatch(r'[1-9][0-9]*', num_cpus), 'CPU usage NumCPUs invalid'
    cpus = {'NumCPUs': int(num_cpus)}
    for name in ('ReqTRES', 'AllocTRES', 'TRES'):
        value = fields.get(name)
        if value in (None, '', '(null)', 'N/A', 'None'):
            continue
        tres = {}
        for item in value.split(','):
            key, count = item.split('=', 1)
            assert key not in tres, 'CPU usage duplicate TRES'
            tres[key] = count
        if 'cpu' in tres:
            assert re.fullmatch(r'[1-9][0-9]*', tres['cpu']), 'CPU usage TRES CPU invalid'
            cpus[name] = int(tres['cpu'])
    # Older Slurm may expose only TRES/NumCPUs; count their maximum, not an assumed allocation.
    return dict(job_id=identity, state=expected['state'], partition=expected['partition'],
                job_name=expected['name'], account=fields['Account'], qos=fields['QOS'],
                observed_cpu_fields=cpus, cpu_upper_bound=max(cpus.values()),
                explicit_allocated_cpu=cpus.get('AllocTRES'))


def collect_cpu_usage(queue_text):
    started = time.monotonic()
    before = queue_records(queue_text)
    jobs = []
    for identity, expected in before.items():
        p = subprocess.run(['scontrol', 'show', 'job', identity, '-o'], capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=30)
        assert p.returncode == 0 and len(p.stdout.encode()) + len(p.stderr.encode()) < 65536, 'CPU usage metadata query failed'
        jobs.append(job_cpu_record(job_fields(p.stdout), identity, expected))
    p = subprocess.run(['squeue', '-h', '-u', 'zqchen', '-o', '%i|%T|%P|%j|%r|%b'],
                       capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=30)
    assert p.returncode == 0 and len(p.stdout.encode()) < 131072, 'CPU usage coherence query failed'
    assert queue_records(p.stdout) == before, 'CPU usage queue changed during snapshot'
    elapsed = time.monotonic() - started
    assert elapsed <= 120, 'CPU usage snapshot freshness budget exceeded'
    return dict(status='coherent_own_job_CPU_upper_bound_snapshot', jobs=jobs, elapsed_seconds=elapsed,
                queue_sha256=hashlib.sha256(queue_text.encode()).hexdigest(),
                pending_cpu_upper_bound=sum(x['cpu_upper_bound'] for x in jobs if x['state'] == 'PENDING'),
                active_cpu_upper_bound=sum(x['cpu_upper_bound'] for x in jobs if x['state'] != 'PENDING'),
                known_explicit_allocated_cpu=sum(x['explicit_allocated_cpu'] or 0 for x in jobs),
                all_active_allocations_explicit=all(x['explicit_allocated_cpu'] is not None for x in jobs if x['state'] != 'PENDING'),
                scope='all_own_jobs_conservative_including_pending_requests_not_measured_GPU_usage')


def validate_cpu_usage_limit(snapshot, row, key):
    assert key == 'MaxTRESPU', 'account aggregate TRES needs an independent account-wide audit'
    limits = {}
    for item in row[key].split(','):
        resource, value = item.split('=', 1)
        assert resource not in limits, 'aggregate QoS TRES duplicate'
        limits[resource] = value
    assert set(limits) == {'cpu'} and re.fullmatch(r'[1-9][0-9]*', limits['cpu']), 'aggregate non-CPU limit not reviewed'
    usage = snapshot['cpu_usage']
    assert usage['status'] == 'coherent_own_job_CPU_upper_bound_snapshot', 'CPU usage snapshot incomplete'
    queue = snapshot['scheduler']['own_queue']['stdout']
    assert usage['queue_sha256'] == hashlib.sha256(queue.encode()).hexdigest(), 'CPU usage queue binding drift'
    records = queue_records(queue)
    assert len(usage['jobs']) == len(records) and {x['job_id'] for x in usage['jobs']} == set(records), 'CPU usage job coverage drift'
    assert usage['elapsed_seconds'] <= 120, 'CPU usage snapshot stale'
    for job in usage['jobs']:
        assert job['state'] == records[job['job_id']]['state'] and job['cpu_upper_bound'] > 0, 'CPU usage record drift'
    pending = sum(x['cpu_upper_bound'] for x in usage['jobs'] if x['state'] == 'PENDING')
    active = sum(x['cpu_upper_bound'] for x in usage['jobs'] if x['state'] != 'PENDING')
    assert pending == usage['pending_cpu_upper_bound'] and active == usage['active_cpu_upper_bound'], 'CPU usage sum drift'
    total = pending + active + 8
    assert total <= int(limits['cpu']), 'aggregate CPU QoS capacity insufficient'
    usage.setdefault('checked_limits', []).append(dict(qos=row['Name'], per_user_cpu_limit=int(limits['cpu']),
        pending_cpu_upper_bound=pending, active_cpu_upper_bound=active, new_job_cpus=8, prospective_cpu_upper_bound=total))

def bootstrap_only(script, probe):
    lines = script.splitlines()
    payloads = [i for i, line in enumerate(lines) if line.startswith('exec "$CONDA_PREFIX/bin/python" -B ')]

"""R3 remote protocol: freeze once, submit held, independently release the same ID."""
import csv
from datetime import datetime, timezone
import hashlib
import io
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import re
import shutil
import subprocess

CONTEXT = {}
LOCK_SHA = '866d02c7106d809d4f14b87c0da101e2c3c722ab50f7a8f78e3ea89fb5fc2d77'


def command(argv, timeout=30):
    p = subprocess.run(argv, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=timeout)
    require(len(p.stdout.encode())+len(p.stderr.encode()) < 131072, 'command output budget')
    return dict(argv=argv, returncode=p.returncode, stdout=p.stdout, stderr=p.stderr)


def light_result(attempt, outcome):
    files = {}
    for path in sorted((attempt/'operator').glob('*.json')):
        require(path.stat().st_size < 131072, 'light audit file budget')
        files[path.name] = dict(bytes=path.stat().st_size, sha256=sha(path), content=json.loads(path.read_text()))
    return dict(META, **outcome, light_audit_files=files,
                contract=json.loads((attempt/'contract/PREPARATION_CONTRACT.json').read_text()),
                frozen_slurm=(attempt/'slurm/prepare.slurm').read_text())


def validate_package(attempt, contract):
    root = Path(contract['remote_root'])
    require(attempt == root/'attempts/s0_cpu_prepare_r3a' and contract['attempt'] == str(attempt), 'R3 attempt drift')
    require(Path(contract['build_env']).name == 'bio_build_glibc217_r2', 'R3 must reuse R2 environment')
    require(contract['resource'] == dict(partition='cpu_192G', cpus_per_task=8, memory_gib=64,
                                       time_limit='04:00:00', gpu=0), 'R3 resource drift')
    require(contract['single_conversion_deadline_seconds'] == 7200 and not contract['automatic_retry'], 'R3 conversion policy drift')
    require(prior_guard(root) == contract['prior_guard'], 'prior environment or failure drift')
    require(parent_staging_guard(root) == contract['parent_attempt_files'], 'parent R1 staging drift')
    require(parent_r2_guard(root) == contract['parent_R2_attempt_files'], 'parent R2 attempt drift')
    r3_evidence_guard(attempt, contract)
    require(failed_r3_guard(root)==contract['failed_R3_attempt_files'], 'failed R3 inventory changed')
    for name, digest in contract['package_files'].items():
        require(sha(attempt/name) == digest, 'R3 runtime drift: '+name)
        compile((attempt/name).read_text(), name, 'exec')
    for name, digest in contract['build_env_files'].items():
        require(sha(Path(contract['build_env'])/name) == digest, 'R2 build environment drift: '+name)
    for name, item in SOURCES.items():
        path = attempt/'sources'/item['filename']
        require(path.stat().st_size == item['bytes'] and sha(path) == item['sha256'], 'R3 sdist drift: '+name)
    require(sha(Path(contract['compiler_preflight'])/'COMPLETE.json') == contract['compiler_preflight_sha256'], 'compiler acceptance drift')
    require(sha(Path(contract['compiler_solver_preflight'])/'FAILED.json') == contract['original_R3_failed_sha256'], 'original solver failure drift')


def freeze_r3(root, parent_contract, files, authorization, bootstrap_proof):
    attempt = root/'attempts/s0_cpu_prepare_r3a'
    require(not attempt.exists(), 'R3 attempt already exists; inspect without retry')
    prior, first_parent, second_parent = prior_guard(root), parent_staging_guard(root), parent_r2_guard(root)
    failed_before = failed_r3_guard(root)
    require(prior == parent_contract['prior_guard'] and first_parent == parent_contract['parent_attempt_files'], 'parent provenance drift')
    require(shutil.disk_usage(root).free > parent_contract['incremental_budget_bytes'], 'fresh R3 staging capacity')
    require(sha(parent_contract['archive']) == parent_contract['archive_sha256'] == ARCHIVE_SHA, 'accepted archive drift')
    require(set(files) == {'s0_build_contract.py', 'prepare_s0_cpu_r3a.py', 's0_source_requirements_r2.py'}, 'R3 runtime set drift')
    for name, source in files.items():
        compile(source, name, 'exec')
    references = {relative: root/'attempts/s0_cpu_prepare_r2'/relative for relative in
                  ('contract/BUILD_ENV_EXPLICIT.txt', 'reports/SOURCE_BUILD_REQUIREMENTS.json')}
    for relative, original in references.items():
        expected = LOCK_SHA if relative.endswith('BUILD_ENV_EXPLICIT.txt') else parent_contract['source_build_requirements_sha256']
        require(original.is_file() and original.stat().st_size < 131072, 'parent reference missing or above light budget: '+relative)
        require(sha(original) == expected, 'parent reference SHA drift: '+relative)
    attempt.mkdir(mode=0o700)
    CONTEXT.update(owns_audit=True, audit=str(attempt/'operator'), stage='freeze_R3_package', job_id=None)
    for name in ('runtime', 'contract', 'sources', 'logs', 'reports', 'wheels', 'wheel_probe', 'scratch', 'operator', 'slurm'):
        (attempt/name).mkdir(mode=0o700)
    write(attempt/'contract/USER_AUTHORIZATION.json', authorization)
    write(attempt/'contract/BOOTSTRAP_VERIFICATION.json', bootstrap_proof)
    for relative, original in references.items():
        with original.open('rb') as src, (attempt/relative).open('xb') as dst:
            shutil.copyfileobj(src, dst)
        (attempt/relative).chmod(0o440)
    for name, source in files.items():
        path = attempt/'runtime'/name
        with path.open('x') as stream:
            stream.write(source)
        path.chmod(0o440)
    for item in SOURCES.values():
        original = root/'attempts/s0_cpu_prepare_r2/sources'/item['filename']
        require(original.stat().st_size == item['bytes'] and sha(original) == item['sha256'], 'parent sdist drift')
        with original.open('rb') as src, (attempt/'sources'/item['filename']).open('xb') as dst:
            shutil.copyfileobj(src, dst)
        (attempt/'sources'/item['filename']).chmod(0o440)
    contract = json.loads(json.dumps(parent_contract))
    contract.update(attempt=str(attempt), parent_R2_attempt_files=second_parent, failed_R3_attempt_files=failed_before,
                    package_files={'runtime/'+name: hashlib.sha256(source.encode()).hexdigest() for name, source in files.items()},
                    parent_R2_contract_sha256=sha(root/'attempts/s0_cpu_prepare_r2/contract/PREPARATION_CONTRACT.json'),
                    initialization_policy='nounset_after_system_conda_module_initialization',
                    user_authorization_sha256=sha(attempt/'contract/USER_AUTHORIZATION.json'),
                    build_env_explicit_sha256=sha(attempt/'contract/BUILD_ENV_EXPLICIT.txt'),
                    bootstrap_verification_sha256=sha(attempt/'contract/BOOTSTRAP_VERIFICATION.json'))
    path = attempt/'contract/PREPARATION_CONTRACT.json'
    write(path, contract)
    script = render_slurm(attempt, contract['build_env'], os.environ['EXTERNAL_MET_CONDA_BIN'], sha(path))
    slurm = attempt/'slurm/prepare.slurm'
    with slurm.open('x') as stream:
        stream.write(script)
    slurm.chmod(0o440)
    return attempt, json.loads(path.read_text())


def prepare_held(payload):
    root = Path(os.environ['EXTERNAL_MET_REMOTE_ROOT'])
    authorization, proof = payload['authorization'], payload['bootstrap_proof']
    require(authorization['single_R3_CPU_held_submission_and_release_authorized'], 'R3 not authorized')
    require(not authorization['environment_reinstallation_authorized'] and not authorization['solver_rerun_authorized'], 'R3 scope drift')
    require(proof['pass_bootstrap_only'] and not proof['full_preparation_pass'] and not proof['GPU_pass'], 'bootstrap proof invalid')
    parent_r2_guard(root)
    terminal = command(['sacct', '-P', '-j', '4304740', '--format=JobID,State,ExitCode,Elapsed'])
    rows = list(csv.DictReader(io.StringIO(terminal['stdout']), delimiter='|'))
    allocation = [r for r in rows if r['JobID'] == '4304740']
    require(terminal['returncode'] == 0 and len(allocation) == 1 and allocation[0]['State'] == 'FAILED'
            and allocation[0]['ExitCode'] == '1:0', 'parent R2 failed terminal not established')
    parent_contract = json.loads((root/'attempts/s0_cpu_prepare_r2/contract/PREPARATION_CONTRACT.json').read_text())
    require(parent_contract['remote_root'] == str(root), 'remote root identity drift')
    attempt, contract = freeze_r3(root, parent_contract, payload['files'], authorization, proof)
    audit = attempt/'operator'
    CONTEXT['stage'] = 'exact_R3_bootstrap_and_static_preflight'
    validate_package(attempt, contract)
    require(command(['/bin/bash', '-n', str(attempt/'slurm/prepare.slurm')])['returncode'] == 0, 'R3 Bash syntax failed')
    script = (attempt/'slurm/prepare.slurm').read_text()
    clean = dict(HOME=os.environ['HOME'], USER='zqchen', LOGNAME='zqchen', SHELL='/bin/bash',
                 PATH='/usr/bin:/bin', LANG='C', PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE='1')
    p = subprocess.run(['/bin/bash', '-s'], input=bootstrap_only(script, PROBE), env=clean,
                       capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=180)
    require(len(p.stdout.encode())+len(p.stderr.encode()) < 131072, 'exact R3 bootstrap output budget')
    markers = [line[len('S0_BOOTSTRAP_PROBE='):] for line in p.stdout.splitlines() if line.startswith('S0_BOOTSTRAP_PROBE=')]
    write(audit/'BOOTSTRAP_EXECUTION.json', dict(returncode=p.returncode, stdout=p.stdout, stderr=p.stderr,
                                               slurm_sha256=sha(attempt/'slurm/prepare.slurm')))
    require(p.returncode == 0 and len(markers) == 1, 'exact R3 bootstrap failed; no job')
    probe = json.loads(markers[0])
    require(probe['status'] == 'bootstrap_import_compiler_CLI_probe_pass_not_artifact_pass', 'R3 bootstrap probe status')
    require(all(probe[k] is False for k in ('images_read', 'models_loaded', 'packages_installed', 'assets_written')), 'R3 probe scope drift')
    CONTEXT['stage'] = 'fresh_R3_scheduler_and_capacity'
    queries = {
        'qos': ['sacctmgr', '-P', 'show', 'qos'],
        'partition': ['scontrol', 'show', 'partition', 'cpu_192G', '-o'],
        'nodes': ['sinfo', '-N', '-h', '-p', 'cpu_192G', '-o', '%N|%t|%c|%m|%G'],
        'association': ['sacctmgr', '-P', 'show', 'assoc', 'where', 'user=zqchen',
                        'format=User,Account,Partition,QOS,MaxJobs,MaxSubmitJobs'],
        'own_queue': ['squeue', '-h', '-u', 'zqchen', '-o', '%i|%T|%P|%j|%r|%b'],
        'quota': ['quota', '-s'], 'libc': ['getconf', 'GNU_LIBC_VERSION'],
    }
    scheduler = {name: command(argv) for name, argv in queries.items()}
    snapshot = dict(scheduler=scheduler, free_bytes=shutil.disk_usage(root).free,
                    cpu_usage=collect_cpu_usage(scheduler['own_queue']['stdout']))
    write(audit/'RESOURCE_SNAPSHOT.json', snapshot)
    validation = validate_cpu_snapshot(snapshot)
    require(not any(r['name'] == 's2exts0p3a' for r in queue_records(scheduler['own_queue']['stdout']).values()), 'R3 job already queued')
    require(snapshot['free_bytes'] > contract['incremental_budget_bytes'], 'R3 fresh capacity failed')
    validate_package(attempt, contract)
    static = dict(status='CPU_static_and_fresh_scheduler_pass', validation=validation,
                  cpu_usage=snapshot['cpu_usage'], contract_sha256=sha(attempt/'contract/PREPARATION_CONTRACT.json'),
                  slurm_sha256=sha(attempt/'slurm/prepare.slurm'), remote_utc=datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat())
    write(audit/'STATIC_PREFLIGHT.json', static)
    write(attempt/'reports/STAGING_COMPLETE.json', dict(status='S0_offline_CPU_input_staging_pass_not_model_runtime_pass',
          contract_sha256=static['contract_sha256'], environment_reinstalled=False, solver_rerun=False,
          remote_utc=datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()))
    write(audit/'RESERVATION.json', dict(static, status='R3_single_submission_reserved'))
    CONTEXT['stage'] = 'sbatch_held_once'
    result = command(['sbatch', '--hold', '--parsable', '--chdir='+str(attempt), str(attempt/'slurm/prepare.slurm')], timeout=60)
    write(audit/'SBATCH_RESULT.json', result)
    require(result['returncode'] == 0, 'R3 sbatch nonzero; no retry')
    match = re.fullmatch(r'([0-9]+)(?:;[A-Za-z0-9_.-]+)?', result['stdout'].strip())
    require(match is not None, 'R3 JobID unclear; inspect without retry')
    job_id = match.group(1)
    CONTEXT.update(stage='independent_held_identity_audit', job_id=job_id)
    write(audit/'HELD_CREATED.json', dict(static, status='CPU_held_created', job_id=job_id))
    observed = command(['scontrol', 'show', 'job', job_id, '-o'])
    require(observed['returncode'] == 0, 'R3 held query failed')
    fields = validate_held(observed['stdout'], job_id, attempt, [validation['account']])
    require(fields['QOS'].lower() in [q.lower() for q in validation['applicable_qos']], 'R3 held QoS drift')
    write(audit/'HELD_AUDIT.json', dict(status='CPU_held_identity_pass', job_id=job_id, fields=fields,
          raw_scontrol=observed['stdout'], remote_utc=datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()))
    return light_result(attempt, dict(status='R3_CPU_submitted_held_not_released', job_id=job_id,
                        slurm_sha256=static['slurm_sha256'], contract_sha256=static['contract_sha256'],
                        remote_utc=datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(), original_inference_jobs_created=False))


def release_held(payload):
    root = Path(os.environ['EXTERNAL_MET_REMOTE_ROOT'])
    attempt, audit = root/'attempts/s0_cpu_prepare_r3a', root/'attempts/s0_cpu_prepare_r3a/operator'
    require(not (audit/'RELEASE_RESULT.json').exists() and not (audit/'SUBMISSION_RECEIPT.json').exists(), 'R3 release already attempted')
    created = json.loads((audit/'HELD_CREATED.json').read_text())
    job_id = created['job_id']
    require(payload['job_id'] == job_id and payload['local_held_verification_pass'] is True, 'local held verification missing')
    require(sha(audit/'HELD_AUDIT.json') == payload['held_audit_sha256'], 'held audit identity drift')
    require(sha(attempt/'contract/PREPARATION_CONTRACT.json') == created['contract_sha256'] == payload['contract_sha256'], 'R3 contract changed while held')
    require(sha(attempt/'slurm/prepare.slurm') == created['slurm_sha256'] == payload['slurm_sha256'], 'R3 Slurm changed while held')
    contract = json.loads((attempt/'contract/PREPARATION_CONTRACT.json').read_text())
    validate_package(attempt, contract)
    require(shutil.disk_usage(root).free > contract['incremental_budget_bytes'], 'R3 release fresh capacity failed')
    observed = command(['scontrol', 'show', 'job', job_id, '-o'])
    require(observed['returncode'] == 0, 'held identity requery failed')
    validation = json.loads((audit/'STATIC_PREFLIGHT.json').read_text())['validation']
    fields = validate_held(observed['stdout'], job_id, attempt, [validation['account']])
    require(fields['QOS'].lower() in [q.lower() for q in validation['applicable_qos']], 'release QoS identity drift')
    CONTEXT.update(owns_audit=True, audit=str(audit), stage='release_same_held_job_once', job_id=job_id)
    write(audit/'LOCAL_HELD_VERIFICATION.json', payload)
    release = command(['scontrol', 'release', job_id])
    write(audit/'RELEASE_RESULT.json', dict(job_id=job_id, **release, remote_utc=datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()))
    require(release['returncode'] == 0, 'R3 release failed; no retry')
    observed = command(['scontrol', 'show', 'job', job_id, '-o'])
    require(observed['returncode'] == 0, 'post-release state unavailable; inspect without resubmission')
    outcome = dict(status='CPU_preparation_job_released_not_artifact_or_model_runtime_pass', job_id=job_id,
                   slurm_sha256=created['slurm_sha256'], contract_sha256=created['contract_sha256'],
                   observed_job=job_fields(observed['stdout']), remote_utc=datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),
                   models_loaded=False, images_read=False, original_inference_jobs_created=False)
    write(audit/'SUBMISSION_RECEIPT.json', outcome)
    return light_result(attempt, outcome)


def execute(action, payload):
    CONTEXT.clear()
    try:
        require(action in ('prepare_held', 'release_held'), 'unrecognized R3 protocol action')
        return prepare_held(payload) if action == 'prepare_held' else release_held(payload)
    except BaseException as error:
        result = dict(META, status='R3_CPU_operation_stopped_no_automatic_retry', stage=CONTEXT.get('stage', 'preflight'),
                      job_id=CONTEXT.get('job_id'), message=str(error), error_type=type(error).__name__,
                      remote_utc=datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(), no_automatic_retry=True)
        if CONTEXT.get('owns_audit'):
            audit = Path(CONTEXT['audit'])
            audit.mkdir(mode=0o700, exist_ok=True)
            name = 'SUBMISSION_FAILED.json' if action == 'prepare_held' else 'RELEASE_FAILED.json'
            if not (audit/name).exists():
                write(audit/name, result)
        return result
